flammability.doc: flammability above 0.3 makes this eligible for item burners.

charge.doc: how electrically potent this item is.

cost.doc:
base material cost of this item, used for calculating place times
1 cost = 1 tick added to build time

healthScaling.doc: When this item is present in the build cost, a block's default health is multiplied by 1 + scaling, where 'scaling' is summed together for all item requirement types.

lowPriority.doc: if true, this item is of the lowest priority to drills.

transitionFrames.doc: Number of generated transition frames between each frame

buildable.doc: If true, this material is used by buildings. If false, this material will be incinerated in certain cores.
